// diagnostic

E0731

`{tag}` is a tag, but {context} needs a trait.

What

`{tag}` is a tag, but {context} needs a trait.

Why

A `tag` is a marker that erases at runtime and carries no methods; dispatch and method attachment need a `trait`.

Fix

Declare `{tag}` as a `trait` with the method(s) it should provide.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0731: tests/ui/derive_tag.stderr.

Error [E0731]: `Reviewed` is a tag, but `derive` needs a trait

    |

    |  ^^^^^^^^
 Why: a `tag` is a marker that erases at runtime and carries no methods; dispatch and method attachment need a `trait`
 Fix: declare `Reviewed` as a `trait` with the method(s) it should provide

Error [E0927]: `#Reviewed` isn't a known applied rule
  --> tests/ui/derive_tag.jet:5:2
    |
  5 | #Reviewed
    |  ^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Reviewed` isn't registered as an applied rule — Jet rules are a closed, registered vocabulary (I7), not any PascalCase word.
 Fix: check the spelling, or see docs/spec/syntax-decisions.md for the full applied-rule list.
